provenance.construction: Concatenation of the CSS code [[72,14,8]] (codes/72-14-8.json, outer) with the non-CSS stabilizer code [[8,3,3]] (codes/8-3-3.json, inner): the finite reading of the concatenate-then-unconcatenate mechanism of arXiv:2610.04694. n = n_in*n_out, k = k_in*k_out, and d >= d_in*d_out, since a nontrivial outer logical costs at least d_out blocks at >= d_in each. Checks are the inner stabilizers on every block plus each outer check lifted through a min-weight symplectic basis of the inner logical space; the witness is the outer's own witness lifted through a weight-4 (weight-3) inner logical.

search_budget.notes: RIS over the Pauli normalizer of the concatenated code; the lifted witness was constructed, not searched

provenance.notes: Equivalence checked by the gate: no exact or WL-equivalent entry on the board, and the product is new parameters rather than a relabeling -- no block Clifford is applied, the outer checks are lifted through the inner code's logical space. The parents are board entries codes/8-3-3.json and codes/72-14-8.json; both carry upper-bound distances, so this one is inherited twice over and stays an upper bound.
